blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for regulatory and compliance work — reviewing uploaded regulatory updates, diffing rules against internal policy, tracking gaps and comment periods, and drafting policy revisions. Each prompt runs on its own; the workflows offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: Regulatory Practice Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that builds a reusable Regulatory Practice Profile — regulatory footprint, materiality threshold, policy library, and escalation. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: Uploaded Regulatory Update Review
prompts.description: Review an uploaded regulatory update — final rule, NPRM, guidance, enforcement order — and produce a structured summary classified by materiality.

prompts.title: Regulation-to-Policy Diff
prompts.description: Diff an uploaded regulation against your uploaded internal policies and surface where they no longer line up.

prompts.title: Compliance Gap Tracker
prompts.description: Maintain a compliance gap tracker — open gaps by age and materiality, remediation status, owner notifications, and close / risk-accept decisions.

prompts.title: NPRM Comment Tracker
prompts.description: Track open NPRM comment periods — deadlines, file / not-file decisions, and a decision log.

prompts.title: Policy Redraft
prompts.description: Propose targeted revisions to an uploaded internal policy in response to a regulatory change or identified gap.
